reason: We get pitched on 3D walkthroughs constantly and most of my clients come from referrals who already trust us, so I don't have a problem this solves. For spec homes from a plan library, $1,500 a pop is hard to justify when we can show a model or past builds.
objection: I can't bill it cost-plus unless the homeowner agrees to pay, and most won't pay $1,500 for something they didn't ask for. So it would come out of my margin.
would_change_my_mind: If I could show a homeowner it directly cuts change orders and a few of them said they'd pay for it as a line item, or if it were a flat fee for my whole plan library.
